prompts.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE finished Steam LIBRARY CAPSULE for the psychological horror game IT WANTS YOU TO STAY, using image 1 as the approved marketing identity and artwork. Recompose for a genuinely tall portrait image in exact 2:3 aspect ratio (600x900 target; 1200x1800 high-resolution master). Do not squeeze or crop the existing poster.
Match precisely: warm ivory DIN-style condensed uppercase lettering with thin muted oxblood offset; nested three-open-doorway emblem; aged casino with burgundy and gold damask wallpaper, dark wood wainscoting, patterned red carpet, amber sconces and ornate ceiling. In the lower central frame, an open doorway reveals a receding empty office corridor, pale mint walls, teal carpet, ceiling grid of cold fluorescent lights. All locations feel physically connected, not a montage. Cinematic, tangible, premium horror key art. Eerie absence, no person or monster.
For the taller format: title occupies upper 36 percent, eerie doorway and receding corridor occupy lower 57 percent, foreground carpet leads the eye towards threshold. Use this exact title linebreak:
IT WANTS
YOU TO
STAY
STAY is largest. All letters sharp, strong, easily legible at 300x450. Keep title safely within 7 percent margins. Small clean nested-door emblem centered below STAY. Same balanced forms and colors as reference. Allow more tall doorway depth than original while keeping title prominent.
Only those FIVE words appear. Absolutely no subtitles, tagline, marketing copy, quotes, review scores, awards, dates, publisher text, platform marks, fine print, watermarks, guide lines, or poster mockup. Full bleed artwork fills the entire 2:3 portrait.

Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE rich cinematic STEAM LIBRARY HERO BACKGROUND. The attached image is our approved game key art; use it ONLY as a visual world reference. REMOVE ALL title, words and emblem completely in the new composition.
Target output EXACTLY 3840 pixels wide by 1240 pixels high: an ultrawide panoramic aspect ratio 3.09677:1. Render with the maximum fine-detail resolution available, ideally native 3840x1240. Full bleed, no letterboxing.
Recompose the SAME aged casino-to-office world as a much WIDER and DEEPER empty room viewed squarely towards the far wall. Burgundy/gold damask, dark timber panels, faded richly patterned red carpet, ornate dark ceiling, subdued golden sconces. The scene is theatrical, tangible, lived-in and quietly impossible, with warm casino colors contrasted with a cold mint office corridor seen through ONE small distant open doorway at the exact center. The distant door's opening gives a tantalizing glimpse of teal carpet and fluorescent rectangles receding into another space.
CRITICAL STEAM SAFE AREA: in the final 3840x1240 image the central safe rectangle is x=1490..2350, y=430..810 (860x380). The meaningful focal detail -- the ENTIRE inner opening of the distant cold office doorway -- must be completely inside that safe rectangle. Place the doorway center at (1920,620); inner opening around 220 pixels wide by 330 pixels tall. This requires a WIDE view of a LARGE room, not a close shot of a huge doorway. Around it, richly atmospheric casino architecture spreads across the panorama. Beautiful near-to-far perspective, polished lighting restraint, subtle analog texture.
The bottom-left quarter must be especially dark and calm so a SEPARATE ivory logo can later sit there. Do not place any title or logo now. No bright light at bottom left. No critical character/prop at outer edges. Peripheral scenery may be cropped safely. Avoid any central high-contrast giant foreground objects or columns blocking the distant door. Make empty space and unusual light compelling, with no fog clouds, excessive visual noise, people, monsters, artificial black bars, UI overlays, watermark, letters, signs or numbers.
The output is only environmental art, no typography or logo of any kind. Preserve the reference's exact material/color identity while changing viewpoint to suit the panorama.

Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE transparent PNG logo asset for the game IT WANTS YOU TO STAY. The attached header supplies the EXISTING APPROVED logo design; extract/recreate that exact branding, with no rebranding, no scene and no architecture background.
The logo consists of a warm ivory (#ede7d5) nested-doorway emblem on the left, and large warm ivory condensed bold uppercase type on the right. Match the reference's clean DIN Condensed-style shapes, thick verticals, narrow counters, tight well-balanced spacing, and subtle muted dark oxblood offset shadow. The emblem is exactly THREE nested inverted-U rectangular door outlines, open at the bottom, sharing one baseline. Emblem slender strokes are proportional to the reference and clean.
Two lines of type, same size on both lines, left-aligned:
IT WANTS
YOU TO STAY
The second line naturally runs wider. Do not add a third line. Keep emblem height approximately equal to the total two-line text block.
Canvas target is 1280px wide x 480px tall (ratio 8:3); master may be 2560x960 if needed. Fill canvas well, with roughly 4 percent transparent padding on all sides. Entire lockup fits cleanly, no cropping. Title and emblem remain fully opaque ivory with a very subtle narrow dark-red drop shadow for contrast on game art.
ABSOLUTELY TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND (actual alpha channel). Transparency around the whole logo and inside all letter counters and emblem openings. Do not draw a checkerboard, black rectangle, white rectangle, texture, casino wall, corridor, frame or any background at all. No glow, no bevel, no metallic finish, no extra shapes. Only the five exact title words and the existing nested-door mark. Ready to overlay independently on a Steam Library Hero.

Use case: logo-brand. Produce a pristine, flat, vector-style transparent PNG of the existing game logo. Use image 1 only as the exact identity reference: nested three-door emblem left, title right. This is a CLEAN LOGO ASSET, not a photograph, scene, sticker, plaque, sign, or realistic object.
Canvas is 1280x480 aspect ratio 8:3. Only SOLID UNIFORM warm ivory #EDE7D5 shapes on a truly TRANSPARENT background, including all spaces, counters and the openings in the emblem. The artwork must have perfect smooth crisp anti-aliased edges, no fringe pixels and no glow. DO NOT use any shadows at all: no red offset, dark drop shadow, gray outline, bevel, gradient, texture or lighting. No surrounding glow, no halos, no background rectangle, no gray checkerboard.
Exact five words in the existing clean bold DIN Condensed-style uppercase font, two lines left aligned:
IT WANTS
YOU TO STAY
Maintain exactly the same type size for both lines and the reference letterforms. The second line naturally runs wider. Thick even strokes and clean counters; restrained tight spacing.
On the left, exactly THREE nested inverted-U open-bottom door outlines, sharing a single baseline, with solid ivory clean strokes. No fourth rectangle or bottom border. Emblem height matches the overall two-line text block. Leave a clear gap between emblem and title.
Use the canvas efficiently with 4-5% transparent outer padding. Sharp, FLAT two-dimensional professional vector artwork with ABSOLUTELY NO depth treatment. Every filled pixel inside a shape is the same ivory color; all space around the shapes is actual alpha transparency. No other text or symbols.
